LESSON: MIXTURES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Mixtures, Elements and Compounds
Topic 2.1: Mixtures
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 18

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Mixtures, part of Mixtures, Elements and Compounds in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven INTEGRATED SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How is separation of mixtures important in day- to-day life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Collaboratively categorise the mixtures as homogeneous or heterogeneous and record. Learners could use adapted writing materials or type on appropriate digital devices to record.

2. Discuss in purposive groups meaning of the terms solvent, solute and solution. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative communication modes as they share their views during discussion.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Collaboratively categorise the mixtures as homogeneous or heterogeneous and record. Learners could use adapted writing materials or type on appropriate digital devices to record.
2. Discuss in purposive groups meaning of the terms solvent, solute and solution. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative communication modes as they share their views during discussion.
3. Share tasks as they carry out activities to separate homogeneous mixtures. Learners with fine motor difficulties could use alternative functional parts of

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Mixtures together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner learns data presentation as they work collaboratively to categorise the

mixtures as homogeneous or heterogeneous.

• Learning to learn: The learner learns how to separate various mixtures as they carries out activities to separate homogeneous

mixtures.

Values:
Unity: The learner work harmoniously with peers while carrying out activities to separate homogeneous mixtures.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Peer education and mentorship: The leaner practices sharing of tasks as they carry out activities to separate homogeneous

mixtures.
